verdict.rationale: Apify's core product is the Actor model — developers build custom scraping scripts, package them as Actors, and deploy/run them on Apify's managed serverless infrastructure with scheduling, monitoring, proxies, CLI, and SDKs (Python/JS, Crawlee/Playwright/Puppeteer/Scrapy support), all without managing servers. Docs cover development, CLI deployment, scheduling, migration of existing projects, and running via API clients, and community feedback corroborates real-world usage and satisfaction. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark of deployment ease/cold-start behavior and more detail on infra scaling limits.
